reason: I'd try the free tricks first, and if the gallery or the search reveal actually fools my friends at a party on the weekend, I'd pay the 99 the same night. Real magic apps I've bought cost more than that, so for a working set of phone reveals it's fair, even if it stings next to normal apps.
objection: It's a web app paid by card on their own site, not the App Store, so I worry it'll feel clunky, break on my phone after an update, or that I'm handing my card to some unknown site.
would_change_my_mind: If the free tricks feel fake or laggy on my phone, I'm out.
